_doc: SAMPLE / ILLUSTRATIVE. Proposed output shape of the creative assistance engine. Designed so that every finding is traceable to a named authority, because a marketer who is not a designer needs evidence they can defend, not an opinion.
_design_principle: Three tiers. Tier 1 is objective and auto-fixable. Tier 2 is brand-relative and needs a human yes/no. Tier 3 is judgement and is expressed as precedent, never as a verdict.

issue_clusters.title: German headline overflows the text box
issue_clusters.root_cause: Source headline is 34 characters in English, 44 in German. The 9:16 headline box was sized for English.

authority.detail: rendered text exceeds box height by 62px

fix_options.label: Use the approved shorter German headline
Grow the text box 18%
fix_options.side_effect: reduces clear space below logo, would trigger a second flag

fix_options.label: Drop to 72px
fix_options.side_effect: below brand minimum for story placements

issue_clusters.title: Required health-claim disclaimer is missing

authority.source: Brand Kit > Claims and Legal > Mandatory disclaimers

issue_clusters.why_it_matters: The headline uses an approved structure-function claim. In the US that claim carries a mandatory disclaimer inside the creative, not on the landing page.

fix_options.label: Insert disclaimer at 11px in the lower safe area

issue_clusters.cost_of_missing: Meta disapproval or post-launch legal takedown. Historically 3 to 5 lost flight days.

issue_clusters.title: CTA text fails contrast on the citrus accent

authority.rule: halo-cream on halo-citrus is marked prohibited in the Brand Kit pairing rules

issue_clusters.title: Logo clear space is 0.6x, brand requires 1.0x

authority.citation: Halo brand book v6.2, p.14, 'Logo clear space'

issue_clusters.note: Designer locked this element. Overriding requires a reason, which is recorded.

issue_clusters.title: Japanese variants have no CJK glyph coverage

authority.detail: Halo Grotesk lacks glyphs for 31 of 44 characters. Renderer will substitute silently.

fix_options.label: Switch to Noto Sans JP, the Brand Kit approved CJK face

issue_clusters.title: Three headlines use language on the never-say list

authority.source: Brand Kit > Voice > We never say

issue_clusters.note: These came from the AI copy generation step, not from the designer's seed.

issue_clusters.title: Six variants use a hook that underperformed with this audience

authority.detail: 'Unlock your best self' ran to this segment in Q3 2025 and delivered 22% below control CTR.

issue_clusters.framing: This is not a defect. It is a prior. Shown as evidence, decision stays with the marketer.

fix_options.label: Try '30 seconds, not 30 minutes' (+31% CTR, same audience, BTS 2025)

passed_silently: channel aspect ratio and file size
per_variant_example._design_note: What passed is shown, collapsed. A marketer without design confidence needs to see what was checked, not only what failed. Silence is not reassurance.

ship_report._purpose: The artefact that replaces designer sign-off socially. Attachable to the launch ticket.

overrides.reason_given: Reels UI overlays the top area, tighter crop approved verbally by brand team 2026-11-17
